welcomeSubtitle: Nasi isifinyezo sakho semali se-Mukuru sanamuhla.

coachTip.title: Zano Le-AI Lokonga Imali
coachTip.content: Ughcine i-R150 ezintengweni zokudla kule wiki! Faka i-R100 enhlosweni yakho ye-Frosty Fridge ukuze ufinyelele masinyane.

nextStep.title: Isinyathelo Esihlongozwayo
nextStep.content: Beka i-R200 eceleni namhlanje ngaphambi kwezindleko zempelasonto ukuze ufinyelele inhloso yakho izinsuku ezi-4 kusenesikhathi.

groceryAlert.title: Isexwayiso Sezitolo
groceryAlert.content: Impuphu ine-saphulelo se-12% eShoprite kule wiki! Wonga i-R25 ku-10kg.

notifications.n1_desc: Imali yakho yokonga isibaliwe yaba R3,000 ngemva kwezibopho zangakini.
notifications.n2_desc: Inhloso ye-Frosty Fridge ifinyelele ku-20%! Usugcine R1,200.
